newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta stocks seen steady after Monday's record.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta stocks seen steady after Monday's record.

text.p: Jakarta stocks are seen remaining steady on Tuesday after a record closing high on Monday, but brokers said some profit-taking was likely following sharp falls on Wall Street overnight.
They said blue chips including automobile conglomerate Astra and bank BDNI had risen very sharply and that players were likely to begin taking profit.
On Monday, the Jakarta composite index closed 1.04 percent, or 7.41 points, higher at 719.64 points on foreign-led buying in blue-chips and active local buying of secondaries, brokers said.
The previous closing high of 717.47 points was recorded on February 27, 1997.
